summary: v08 as a single decision with a stated probability, for pool models without log-probabilities: the judgement session only (no verification); the case score is the submitted p_ischemic.

Aspect C: the judgement procedure becomes a graded five-line differential table (time course, QRS linkage with positional calls only for a step/abrupt signature and ischemic QRS changes per K18/K19, heart-rate response per K01/K02, shape, noise), a list of non-evidence, and a fixed mapping from the grade total to p_ischemic.

Aspect C: the judgement becomes a signature-based differential in which ischemia (shape, time course, heart-rate relation, depth) and each alternative (heart-rate related only with an actual heart-rate change, early repolarization, position, conduction, noise, reference) count only through their own positive signature elements, generic and record-constant facts are excluded, and a fixed ischemia-count by alternative-strength table sets p_ischemic.

Aspect C: before judging the signature elements the model writes two numeric read-out lines, an ST-shape class from J+20 to J+60 relative to the local change (deciding I1 versus the heart-rate related shape of H2, with the K10 tachycardia picture limited to 100-200 uV) and a linked-heart-rate-rise check (a rise of 10 bpm or more that belongs to this ST change), so that I3b is no longer claimed from a chance heart-rate maximum minutes before the ST extremum.
